watches.description: Atlas Eclipse Solar 32mm The Atlas Eclipse Solar 32mm takes our iconic field watch silhouette and refines it with modern detailing and solar-powered performance. Built for true adventure in a compact form, it’s the perfect blend of rugged functionality and everyday wearability. Designed for quick readability, the oversized luminous markers, bold numerals, and high-contrast dial make it easy to read the time at a glance, even without glasses, and in any light condition. A screw-down crown ensures a secure seal for 100M / 330FT water resistance and a scratchproof sapphire crystal, makes this watch as durable as it is timeless.
